title: AskCatadalf
tagline: A token risk scoring built on top of provable AI with a multi agent system
description:
The chrome extension allows you to take a screenshot of a trading tool and provides you visual summary of a research about the token you are watching.
It provide the following topics: "Team", "Social Media sentiment", "Tokenomics". 
The app provide an onchain proof of the query for trust.
how_its_made:
The project uses galadriel and a multi agent architecture to provide the analysis.
One "master" agent is the personal advisor of the user and knows his risk profil and trading style.
This master agent request analysis to other agents. 

L1: Galadriel
Frontend: React, tailwind, Daisy, Ethers
Tooling: Forge, Git
